# hyperlite_network (Data Source)

A virtual network, to connect VM interfaces to it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperlite_network" "lan" {
  name = "lan"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The network's name.

### Optional

- `node` (String) The cluster member that holds the network, as on its resource (`local` when absent: the node the provider talks to).

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Started.
- `address` (String) The gateway address of a NAT or isolated network.
- `autostart` (Boolean) Started with its node.
- `bridge` (String) The host bridge or interface it sits on.
- `dhcp` (Boolean) Hyperlite hands out addresses on it.
- `id` (String) The network's name.
- `netmask` (String) Its netmask.
- `type` (String) `nat`, `isolated`, `bridge`, `macvtap`...
- `uuid` (String) The network's libvirt UUID.
- `vlan` (Boolean) It carries VLAN tags (an interface may set `vlan_tag`).
